If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is <0.33 in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to counter pessimism.  
If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is rising, cap upward momentum at +2% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to prevent runaway growth.  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, cap downward momentum at -2% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to avoid excessive sell-off.  
For late horizon (16–30 days), if sentiment is >0.67, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast to reflect bullish momentum persistence.  
For late horizon (16–30 days), if sentiment is <0.33, subtract 0.5–1.0% from forecast to reflect bearish momentum persistence.
